experience.description:
Reconcile supplier statements in QuickBooks and summarise unmatched invoices for the accounts lead
Review 45 invoices each week before the payment run and record the approvals
Post purchase entries to the general ledger and check tax codes against the invoices
Prepare petty cash reports from receipts and balance the float each month
Enter staff expenses in Excel and flag claims with missing receipts before the final review
Match delivery notes to approved purchase orders and record short deliveries for the purchasing team
